nodes.label: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey Protein (Double Rich Chocolate, 908g)
nodes.description: Product photo of Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey protein powder. Double Rich Chocolate flavor. Net weight 908g (2lb). 29 servings per container. 24g protein per serving, 5.5g BCAAs, 4g glutamine and glutamic acid. Brand: ON (Optimum Nutrition). Marketed as a source of high quality proteins with 100% of protein from whey.
